facts.fact: Decree 2023-160 creates a finance-ministry unit to run the project to acquire, develop and put into operation a new customs information system, with a three-year first stage covering development and testing.
Customs spokesman Chokri Jarraya said on 12 November 2025 that the SINDA 2 customs system will be ready in 2026, with the first applications entering service at the end of 2025.

note: The page gives only summary survey scores, no statement on customs systems.
Database record; SINDA 2 'in use' conflicts with TUN-002, online services is not a single window.
